source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps subordinate service and entrusted mysteries.
key_decisions.before: Let a person regard us in this way: as servants of Christ and stewards of the mysteries of God.
key_decisions.after: This is how people should regard us: as Christ's servants and stewards of God's mysteries.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Let a person regard us in this way: as servants of Christ and stewards of the mysteries of God.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps comparative dismissal and self-judgment limit.
key_decisions.before: But to me it is a very small thing that I should be judged by you or by any human court; in fact, I do not even judge myself.
key_decisions.after: But to me it is a very small matter to be judged by you or by any human court. I do not even judge myself.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But to me it is a very small thing that I should be judged by you or by any human court; in fact, I do not even judge myself.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps temporal restraint, disclosure, and divine praise.
key_decisions.before: So do not judge anything before the time, until the Lord comes, who will both bring to light the hidden things of darkness and disclose the intentions of the hearts; and then each person’s praise will come from God.
key_decisions.after: Therefore, judge nothing before the appointed time, until the Lord comes. He will bring to light what is hidden in darkness and reveal the purposes of hearts. Then each person's praise will come from God.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Therefore do not judge anything before the time, until the Lord comes, who will both bring to light the hidden things of darkness and disclose the intentions of the hearts; and then each one’s praise will come from God.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves difficult slogan and factional purpose.
key_decisions.before: Now these things, brothers and sisters, I have applied figuratively to myself and Apollos for your sake, so that in us you may learn not to go beyond what is written, so that no one of you becomes arrogant in favor of one against another.
key_decisions.after: Now, brothers and sisters, I have applied these things to myself and Apollos for your sake, so that through us you may learn “not beyond what is written,” and so none of you becomes puffed up for one leader against another.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Now these things, brothers, I have applied figuratively to myself and Apollos for your sake, so that in us you may learn not to go beyond what is written, so that no one of you becomes arrogant in favor of one against another.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains Paul's biting irony and wish.
key_decisions.before: Already you are filled! Already you have become rich! You have become kings without us! And would that you had become kings, so that we also might reign with you!
key_decisions.after: Already you are filled! Already you are rich! You have begun to reign without us! I wish you truly were reigning, so that we might reign with you.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Already you are filled! Already you have become rich! You have become kings without us! And would that you had become kings, so that we also might reign with you!

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves public execution and cosmic spectacle.
key_decisions.before: For I think that God has exhibited us apostles last of all, like men sentenced to death, because we have become a spectacle to the world, both to angels and to men.
key_decisions.after: For I think God has displayed us apostles last, like people sentenced to death, because we have become a spectacle to the world, to angels, and to humans.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For I think that God has exhibited us apostles last of all, like men sentenced to death, because we have become a spectacle to the world, both to angels and to men.

key_decisions.rationale: Names each concrete deprivation and assault.
key_decisions.before: To the present hour we hunger and thirst, and we are poorly clothed and are roughly treated and are homeless,
key_decisions.after: To this very hour we are hungry and thirsty, poorly clothed, beaten, and homeless.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: To the present hour we hunger and thirst, and we are poorly clothed and are roughly treated and are homeless,

key_decisions.rationale: Retains degrading images without softening them.
key_decisions.before: when slandered, we encourage. We have become like the refuse of the world, the offscouring of everything, until now.
key_decisions.after: when slandered, we answer gently. We have become like the world's garbage, everyone's scum, to this very moment.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: when slandered, we encourage. We have become like the refuse of the world, the offscouring of all things, until now.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves exaggerated number and paternal metaphor.
key_decisions.before: For though you have countless instructors in Christ, yet you do not have many fathers; for in Christ Jesus I became your father through the good news.
key_decisions.after: For even if you have ten thousand guardians in Christ, you do not have many fathers, for in Christ Jesus I became your father through the good news.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For though you have countless instructors in Christ, yet you do not have many fathers; for in Christ Jesus I became your father through the gospel.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains disciplinary threat and gentle alternative.
key_decisions.before: What do you want? Will I come to you with a rod, or with love and a spirit of gentleness?
key_decisions.after: What do you want? Shall I come to you with a rod, or with love and a spirit of gentleness?
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: What do you want? Shall I come to you with a rod, or with love and a spirit of gentleness?
